title: A Global Voice 🌎
excerpt: Friends Remover goes global with a complete translation rework, cached languages, translated menus, notifications, Compact Viewer, and more.
body:
After update after update, one feature had quietly remained unfinished: languages. It was a silent, discontinued feature that simply couldn't stay silent anymore. That's why we're excited to announce A Global Voice, a complete rework of languages across Friends Remover.

Translations now work throughout the popup, Settings, Friends List, Unfriend History, Block History, notifications, toasts, and the entire Compact Viewer. The language system has been rebuilt from the ground up to make translations work consistently across Friends Remover.

We've also started using Google's translation API to help power our translations and improve the translation system.

Languages are now cached, meaning your selected language can load much faster when opening the popup or Settings. Cached translations are also updated in the background to keep everything current.

Alongside the language rework, we've fixed several issues across Friends Remover, including banned and deleted friends, popup interactions, button states, theme resets, thumbnails, mutual-friend feedback, and inactivity monitoring.

And that's just some of what's new in A Global Voice.

added.moreInfo: Translations now cover Settings, the popup menu, Friends List, Unfriend History, Block History, notifications, toasts, and the entire Compact Viewer.
Started using Google's translation API to help power translations and improve the translation system.
Selected languages are now cached so translations load much faster in the popup and Settings.
Clicking the + mutual-friends button now shows a toast listing the other mutual friends.

fixed.moreInfo: Fixed the inactivity monitor activating without being enabled and incorrectly removing friends.
Prevented popup menus from being clicked while the scheduled-removal modal is open.
Banned and deleted friends can now be pinned again.
Fixed banned and deleted friends' names not updating or displaying correctly.
Fixed incorrect bust thumbnails briefly appearing when another thumbnail type is selected.
Fixed button states and updated styling while switching between Remove, Cancel, Dismiss, Add Back, Unblock, and Block modes.
Changing the language and clicking Save All no longer resets the selected theme back to blue.
Fixed the Block History bulk-action text to correctly say Dismiss Selected (N) instead of Remove Selected (N).

improved.moreInfo: Single- and multi-friend confirmation messages are now correctly localized across supported languages.
